summary.change: Separated pure Steam Store outcome preparation from ordered database persistence. The existing ok and redirected adapters now share one executor.
summary.refactoring_value: Outcome interpretation can be reviewed and tested without database effects. One executor owns successful-record persistence and guarantees metadata transaction exit before the separate requested-appid mark. Preparation keeps requested appid, body steam_appid and redirect_to visibly distinct.

earlier_checks.result: F401: src.transform.STEAM_STORE_OUTCOME_MESSAGES imported but unused. Fixed with an explicit same-name re-export; all three checks rerun successfully after final edits.

focused_coverage: Missing/falsy non-ok appid returns before malformed body transformation or database effects.
Exact ordinary and invalid-ok mark diagnostics, truncation, fetched_at and is_replay forwarding.
Pure preparation does not mutate input; redirect requested, body and pointer identities remain distinct.
Native malformed-body/error exceptions, missing outcome and unknown envelope version precede database effects.
Exact path-bearing legacy invalid-ok error and original unknown-outcome rejection.
Empty redirect target still marks without a target connection; redirect diagnostics are untruncated.
Real PostgreSQL not_found, transport_error and invalid-ok counters and replay business-state equality.
Real PostgreSQL target commit before mark failure, rollback after target-write failure and mark suppression.
Real PostgreSQL redirect identity separation and replay counters; answered outcome resets transport errors.
tests.execution: Used only the Controller-provisioned facility, waiting for each unit, integration and lint result. No existing tests were edited or skipped.

compatibility.interfaces: Preserved all TASK.json listed signatures, annotations, defaults and import paths; retained the two private adapter signatures. STEAM_STORE_OUTCOME_MESSAGES remains exported from src.load with unchanged contents.
compatibility.semantics: Existing parser and transformer implementations unchanged. Preserved legacy fallback, first-wrapper selection, truthiness, native exceptions, exact diagnostics, branch-specific truncation and outcome return values.
compatibility.persistence: load_transformed_record, mark_steam_store_enrichment_result and all persistence SQL unchanged. Successful metadata uses existing connection/cursor contexts without explicit added commits; redirect marking occurs after target transaction exits and uses its own unchanged transaction.
compatibility.replay: File marks retain is_replay=True and original fetched_at. Existing SQL retains counter comparisons, NULL legacy undercount, error resets and load-time timestamps.
compatibility.scope: No non-Steam-Store loader, dispatch, existing test, dependency, migration or caller changes.

quality.design: One small internal frozen preparation dataclass, three Steam Store-specific pure preparation functions, and one persistence executor; no generic loader framework.
quality.verification: Final authorized source and test bytes passed the sequential required checks. Only the three authorized implementation files and this handoff were intentionally written; Controller-generated check artifacts remain under checks.

limitations: Controller acceptance, independent review and deliberate-regression validation remain Controller responsibilities; no subagents were invoked.
The frozen preparation dataclass contains ordinary dictionaries and is internal; it does not add input validation or deep immutability.
